ABOUT

Bridging Research,
Education, and Clinical Care

Se-Wook Pyo is an associate professor of prosthodontics at Yonsei University College of Dentistry and a prosthodontist at Gangnam Severance Dental Hospital.

His work focuses on implant biomechanics, digital prosthodontics, occlusion and functional rehabilitation, and artificial intelligence for dental imaging and clinical decision support.

RESEARCH

Research Areas

01

AI & Dental Imaging

Panoramic imaging, CBCT, structural feature extraction, implant identification, explainable AI.

02

Implant Biomechanics & Stability

Micromobility, damping capacity, resonance frequency analysis, peri-implant bone loss.

03

Digital Prosthodontics

Intraoral scanning, CAD/CAM, 3D printing, digital denture, and guided workflows.

04

Occlusion & Functional Dentistry

Mandibular position, centric relation, tooth mobility, masticatory function, rehabilitation.

05

Clinical Decision Science

Evidence-based dentistry, clinical scenarios, Delphi studies, and consensus methodology.
